trust.sectionSubtitle: TrustCore is not a checkbox tool. It is a living compliance system.
trust.0desc: Every check, policy, and workflow maps to Quebec's Act to modernize legislative provisions as regards the protection of personal information — not a generic GDPR template.

trust.2desc: Compliance isn't a checkbox. TrustCore tracks your posture over time and alerts you when things slip.
